brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage on Oakhurst Terrace 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-241) before the forecast heat event, as obstructed ventilation must be cleared in preference to deferring it according to SOP-015. For this 42-year-old unit experiencing heavy load through sustained heat with an overnight minimum of 17.76 degrees, apply the loading restrictions in MG-021 if attention before the event is not possible, as outlined in MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period pursuant to MG-021.
